title: Office of Science and Technology Policy: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through
summary: GAO reports that OSTP implemented three of six prior priority recommendations, added one, and now has four priority recommendations focused on national science-and-technology goals and research security. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement while keeping national-goal tracking and research-security information sharing separate.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-109139 OSTP priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: June 2025 baseline through June 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next OSTP priority letter or a named current recommendation changes status.
why_it_matters: The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: The portfolio covers national science-and-technology planning and research security. Implementation counts do not measure research output, innovation quality, security effectiveness, or national readiness.
Action-level closure evidence for the four current priorities and measured outcomes from national-goal tracking or research-security coordination.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
